about.description: USDN is Noble’s yield-bearing dollar stablecoin for Cosmos, implemented as a native Noble chain module and built on M^0’s stablecoin infrastructure. Users mint USDN by depositing USDC and can redeem back. yield is intended to accrue via a global index/rewards mechanism that programmatically directs Treasury-derived returns to the Cosmos ecosystem. Key risks include protocol and governance risk, reliance on the underlying yield source and reserve operations, smart-contract/module risk, and redemption/liquidity mechanics across supported routes.
